items.title: Fixed admission periods replace duration of status for F, J, and I categories
items.shortSummary: DHS replaced duration-of-status admission for F, J, and I nonimmigrants with fixed admission periods and an extension-of-stay process.
items.whyItMatters: Students should review their admission period and program end date with their designated school official before travel, transfer, program changes, or an extension request.

detailSections.heading: What changed
detailSections.body: The final rule establishes fixed admission periods for F, J, and I classifications and procedures for requesting an extension of stay. It also changes several transfer, program-change, and departure-period rules.

detailSections.heading: What to do
detailSections.body: Read the official rule and contact your designated school official for guidance specific to your Form I-20, admission record, program, travel, or practical training.
